scenes.context: 有面光 vs 没面光、开了 vs 没开的对比，打光前后画质差距明显。
sentences: 开了 没开。
On. Off.
on/off（开/关）
有面光 没面光。
With face light, without face light.
face light（面光）
让你拍视频的画面可以自然通透又很高级。
It makes your videos look natural, clear and premium.
premium（高级的）
paraphrase: 换种说法表达对比效果
See the difference the light makes.
换种说法表达画面质感
Your footage instantly looks cleaner and more polished.
scenes.speak: On. Off. With face light, without face light. Good lighting makes your videos look natural, clear and premium.

scenes.title_en: Face Light: Dual Key Lights and a Chin Light
scenes.context: 左前右前两个大主光源让脸立体，桌面反光板从下补光消法令纹泪沟。
sentences: 正面照射我脸的 这是面光。
The light hitting the front of my face is the face light.
hit（照射）
左前方和右前方有两个比较大的主光源。
There are two larger key lights, front left and front right.
key light（主光源）
可以让你的脸看上去更有立体感。
They make your face look more three-dimensional.
three-dimensional（立体的）
通过打光给消掉。
Lighting can smooth them away.
smooth away（消除）
paraphrase: 换种说法表达双主光布置
Put one light on each side in front of you.
换种说法表达反光板补光
A bounce board below fills in the shadows on your face.
scenes.speak: The light hitting the front of my face is the face light. Two larger key lights, front left and front right, make your face look more three-dimensional. A bounce board below can smooth away wrinkles.

scenes.context: 西洋灯加暖色调台灯打到背景，画面更温暖有氛围感。
sentences: 还有一个是打到背景上的背景光。
There's also a background light aimed at the backdrop.
backdrop（背景）
打了背景光之后 就会让整个画面更加的温暖。
With it, the whole frame feels warmer.
warm（温暖的）
更加有氛围感。
It adds so much atmosphere.
atmosphere（氛围）
paraphrase: 换种说法表达背景光作用
Light the background and the mood instantly shifts.
换种说法表达温暖氛围
The shot feels cozier and more inviting.
scenes.speak: There's also a background light aimed at the backdrop. With it, the whole frame feels warmer and full of atmosphere.

scenes.context: 高射灯从上往下打头顶，发丝发光后整个人更精致。
sentences: 发丝光就是一个很高的射灯。
The hair light is a tall spot lamp.
spot lamp（射灯）
从上往下打到脑袋顶上。
It shines from above, down onto the top of your head.
from above（从上方）
整个人好像又精致了不少。
It makes you look more refined.
refined（精致的）
就会显得整个人温柔一点点。
Warm light makes you look a bit softer.
softer（更温柔）
paraphrase: 换种说法表达发丝光效果
A light from above makes your hair glow and you look polished.
换种说法表达暖光效果
Warm tones around your hair add softness.
scenes.speak: The hair light is a tall spot lamp shining from above onto the top of your head. It makes you look more refined. Warm light makes you look a bit softer.

practice: Two larger key lights make your face three-dimensional.
A hair light makes you look more refined.
pitfalls: 面光冷光+背景发丝暖光
shifts: 面光+反光板让脸干净立体
加背景光让画面温暖有氛围
面光、背景光、发丝光三层叠加
